102.content:
Cost of Delay (CoD)	Weighted Shortest Job First (WSJF)
calculation,economic benefit,economic impact,prioritization,prioritization model
Cost of Delay (CoD) and Weighted Shortest Job First (WSJF) are closely related concepts used in prioritization frameworks. Cost of Delay is a critical metric that quantifies the economic impact of delaying a job or task. It serves as the numerator in the WSJF formula, which is used to prioritize jobs. WSJF leverages Cost of Delay as a key component to rank tasks based on their economic impact, ensuring that the most valuable work is addressed first. This prioritization method helps organizations make informed decisions to maximize economic outcomes.<SEP>WSJF uses Cost of Delay as a key component to prioritize jobs based on their economic impact.<SEP>WSJF uses Cost of Delay as the numerator in its formula to prioritize jobs.
